description: Update a product custom field by field_code. Only field_name and ui_visibility can be changed (product fields have no description/important_fields/required_fields).

field_code.description: The field_code (40-char hash for custom fields) from the field create/list response. NOT the human field name.

ui_visibility.description: UI visibility (product fields use a simpler model): add_visible_flag, details_visible_flag.

name: pipedrive_update_product_field
